aliases: 2-(2-氯4-甲磺酰基-3-[(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基]苯甲酰基)环己烷-1,3-二酮
notes: The section glosses the name itself: 除草剂环磺草酮(Tembotrione), and gives the full chemical name, so resolution is supported inside the section. The printed Chinese common name 环磺草酮 deviates from the standard Chinese common name for tembotrione (环磺酮) and is kept verbatim as an alias. The printed chemical name is missing the hyphen after 2-氯 (printed 2-氯4-甲磺酰基, not 2-氯-4-甲磺酰基); recorded exactly as printed. role is other because the background describes it as a marketed Bayer herbicide and no step of this section prepares it. Functional group tags are taken from the printed chemical name.

Named in [0002] as one of the two comparator herbicides 目前市场上的 (currently on the market) whose activity tembotrione exceeds, which is why commercially_available is true. The printed string 硝环磺酮 is not a standard Chinese herbicide common name and does not correspond exactly to any standard name; the EN line leaves it untranslated as well. Recorded exactly as printed with resolved false. No substitution or correction has been attempted and no guess is made about what was intended.

Named in [0002] as the second comparator herbicide 目前市场上的 (currently on the market), which is why commercially_available is true. 甲基磺草酮 is a standard Chinese common name for mesotrione, so it resolves; the EN line leaves it untranslated. No structure is given in this section, so no chemical_family or functional_group tags are emitted.

Named in [0003] as a prior-art reagent, criticised for its strong odour and for the mercaptan it leaves in the waste water. 甲硫醇钠 is the standard Chinese name and resolves unambiguously. It is a bulk commodity reagent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true. No hazard tag is emitted: the patent's complaint is odour and effluent treatment, and neither maps onto the allowed hazard values.

Named in [0003] as 废水中的硫醇 (the mercaptan in the waste water) that is hard to treat. 硫醇 is a class term for thiols and does not identify one specific compound, so it is kept as printed with resolved false. Extracted rather than dropped because the text names it as a chemical species present in the prior-art effluent.

Named in [0003] as the prior-art brominating agent (溴化剂) and described as expensive. The printed form deviates from the standard Chinese name: the patent prints N-溴琥珀酸亚胺, using 琥珀酸亚胺 (succinic acid imide), where the standard name is N-溴代琥珀酰亚胺 (琥珀酰亚胺, succinimide). The identifier keeps the printed form exactly and is not corrected; the English equivalent is carried in aliases only. Bulk commodity reagent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true.
